project.name: VibeControl
project.tagline: Visual Architecture, Codebase Intelligence & Rolling-Wave Control for Vibe Coding
project.proposalSummary: VibeControl replaces static markdown task plans and chaotic chat sessions with an active multi-graph repository control system. It provides an embedded Single Source of Truth (.project-control), an interactive React Flow dashboard, zero-drift codebase intelligence, and rolling-wave prompt compilation for AI coding agents.

activeHorizonTasks.title: Local Bridge & REST Server with Atomic Two-Way Sync
activeHorizonTasks.description: Implement lightweight local HTTP server serving GET/POST /api/project-state with filesystem debouncing, schema validation, and activity logging.
acceptanceCriteria: Local server running on port 4321 with CORS support for Vite dev server
GET /api/project-state returns consolidated multi-layer graph state
POST /api/project-state validates payload with Zod schemas and saves to .project-control/
State mutations write an event to activity.jsonl and broadcast to SSE/WebSocket clients
activeHorizonTasks.notes: Core backend bridge enabling bidirectional React Flow UI synchronization

activeHorizonTasks.title: Multi-Graph React Flow UI Canvas & Custom Nodes
activeHorizonTasks.description: Scaffold Vite + React application with @xyflow/react rendering interactive multi-graph canvas with custom nodes for Milestones, Modules, APIs, Tasks, and Ideation Sticky Notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Vite + React 19 app scaffolded in ui/ folder
Interactive multi-graph canvas with tabbed switching between Roadmap, Architecture, and Ideation views
Custom styled React Flow node components with dark-mode aesthetic and status badges
Node repositioning and edits persist back to local server via POST /api/project-state
activeHorizonTasks.notes: Visual interactive control plane for human developers and vibe coding oversight
